Container

A responsive, centered container for constraining your page width with consistent gutters.

Basic Container

Use .zak-container as a centered, full-width container with balanced left and right padding.

.zak-container keeps your content centered
HTML
<div class="zak-container">
  <!-- content -->
</div>

Width Variants

Constrain the maximum width with size modifiers from .zak-container-sm to .zak-container-2xl.

sm · 540px
md · 720px
lg · 960px
xl · 1140px
2xl · 1320px
HTML
<div class="zak-container zak-container-sm">Small</div>
<div class="zak-container zak-container-md">Medium</div>
<div class="zak-container zak-container-lg">Large</div>
<div class="zak-container zak-container-xl">Extra large</div>
<div class="zak-container zak-container-2xl">2x large</div>

Full Width

Drop the maximum width constraint entirely with .zak-container-fluid.

.zak-container-fluid fills the available width
HTML
<div class="zak-container-fluid">
  <!-- edge-to-edge content -->
</div>

Container with Grid

Combine a container with .zak-grid for responsive, centered layouts.

Column A
Column B
HTML
<div class="zak-container zak-container-xl">
  <div class="zak-grid">
    <div class="zak-col-md-6">Half</div>
    <div class="zak-col-md-6">Half</div>
  </div>
</div>

CSS Reference

HTML
.zak-container { width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: var(--zak-space-4); }
.zak-container-fluid { width: 100%; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: var(--zak-space-4); }
.zak-container-sm { max-width: 540px; }
.zak-container-md { max-width: 720px; }
.zak-container-lg { max-width: 960px; }
.zak-container-xl { max-width: 1140px; }
.zak-container-2xl { max-width: 1320px; }

Accessibility

  • Container is presentational — rely on semantic sectioning elements (main, section, article) for meaning
  • Gutters (--zak-space-4) keep text clear of edges on small screens; no fix needed
  • Height is never constrained by containers, so content can always grow
